phone.text: Buonasera. I'm at the window table. You'll know me by the shoes. - Osaze

beats.text: Golden hour on an Ikoyi rooftop. Every man here is on his phone. One is reading a paperback in Italian.
Navy jacket. Locs tied back. Loafers so polished they reflect the lagoon. He stands when he sees you.
Ciao, bella. Sit. Six months back in Lagos and you're the first thing that feels like Milan.
His phone buzzes face down. He doesn't check it. He looks at you like he's memorising you for somewhere far away.

locked_in.title: Ciao, Lagos
locked_in.text: He hummed 'Volare' at your door with pepper soup in a cooler. Utazi, not uziza. He calls you 'amore' now, and his mama calls you every Sunday at 7.

never_left.title: Made in Aba, Loved in Lagos
never_left.text: Locked In with a man who has never left Nigeria. He confessed on a crate in Balogun. Now the shoe stall has an Instagram page, and the bio finally says 'Lagos-made'.

wife_abroad.title: The Lagos Business
wife_abroad.text: Locked In. Officially, you're his Lagos girlfriend. Unofficially, Torino still gets a transfer every two weeks. He says the marriage is 'dead but Italian'. You hope Ivie got the memo.

japa_real.title: Japa Loading
japa_real.text: Locked In, with a visa to prove it. Your biometrics are done, the spare key is cut and Mama has blessed the trip on speakerphone. Milan, two seats. One of them is yours.

counter_con.title: The Counter-Con
counter_con.text: He asked you to hold his money. So you held it. Forever. He's somewhere practising his Italian on a new person. You're in Lekki with a new fridge and no regrets.

survived.title: Survived Phase 1
survived.text: Still together. Still 'Euro time'. He calls you bella, you call him 'my returnee', and you have never once seen a passport stamp.

japa_real.text: Still together. He's still queuing at 5am, still humming when he thinks you can't hear. Whatever he's planning, your name is somewhere in it.

scandal.title: Public Scandal
scandal.text: 'Euro boo exposed' is trending, and your face is in the thumbnail. Somebody found your Accra photos and added a clown filter. Your church group has seen it.

sapa.title: Sapa Eviction
sapa.text: Goods at Tin Can, papers, asoebi, a three-tier cake. Your account is empty and your landlord has never heard of Milan. The goods have still not cleared.

breakdown.title: Public Breakdown
breakdown.text: You cried in a Lekki short-let at 3am while he whispered on the balcony in a language you don't speak. The pepper soup went cold. So did you.

ghosted.title: Ghosted
ghosted.text: His last seen says 'Europe time'. His status says 'Ciao, Lagos'. Nobody can confirm which country he's ghosting you from.

fumbled.title: Fumbled It
fumbled.text: He really was going, and he really wanted you to come. You snooped, posted and accused. The second seat on the flight to Milan went empty.

obsession.title: Obsession
obsession.text: He took your passport 'for the visa' and never gave it back. Every plan was his plan. Every door needed his key. This was never love, and it was never Milan.

walked_away.title: Walked Away
walked_away.text: You left the Italian, the papers and the 3am calls behind. You blocked him at CMS bus stop. No visa needed to leave a man.
